endpoints.basis: Independent opening/ending pitch plots reject broad-window selections2.86 and283.85 despite numeric pass. First C60/E-flat75 rise around0.7–1.0 before D-flat73; last written E-flat39 then C36 bass pickup is visible near290.8–291.8, followed by A-flat44 and upper C84 rise around292.1–292.5. These identify the actual first phrase and final chord, not the nearest detector peak. No listening claim.

provenance: Original CC0 orchestral MusicXML retained byte-for-byte; only separately licensed analytical lyric nodes are omitted before conversion.
Sounding-pitch changes declared by MusicXML are performed by LilyPond; no blanket woodwind, brass or double-bass octave correction is applied.
